main.מספר תצר: chart-years, kpi:plans, insight:peak — plan key is number + year (numbers repeat across years)
main.גוש: kpi:blocks, chart-block — one block per plan; block number itself is an identifier searchable in the explorer
main.תת גוש: skip: sub-block, 0 on 96% of rows; identifier only
main.סטטוס תצר: chart-years, chart-muni, chart-orderer, chart-block, kpi:registered, kpi:pending, insight:backlog, insight:age
main.סטטוס גוש: chart-block, insight:block — empty values shown as לא צוין
main.שם ישוב: chart-loc, insight:open — 'שטח כללי' (open area outside localities) excluded from the locality chart, disclosed
main.מזמין עבודה: chart-orderer, insight:orderer — garbled (letter-reversed) names and orderers with fewer than 4 plans grouped as אחר, disclosed
